name_ar: مزامنة ذاكرة التعليمات دون تضخم مع تحقق مستقل
name_en: Non-growth instruction-memory sync with independent verify
what: توليد مهارة مزامنة ذاكرة محلية تقارن CLAUDE.md والقواعد وملفات الوكلاء بالشيفرة، فتصلح الحقائق القديمة أولاً ثم تزيل التكرار وتضغط دون أن يكبر أي ملف، مع وكلاء تحقق مستقلين. — Generate a project-local memory-sync skill that diffs CLAUDE.md, rules and agent files against the code, repairs stale facts first, then dedups and compresses so no file grows, with separate verifier agents re-checking every edit.
when: CLAUDE.md or rules drifted from the code; too much always-loaded context; after a branch or commit range changed behavior; requests like 'sync memory', 'slim context', 'clean up agent config'.
how: 1) Resolve the mode (status|install|upgrade|...|purge) from the prompt; print a PLAN block; ask only if destructive. 2) Enumerate the memory surface by command; split into disjoint batches. 3) GATHER: read-only agents list change facts for the scope (session|branch|commit|all). 4) SYNC: one bounded agent per batch, all spawned in one message; facts first, dedup second, compression third; every file ends at or below its line count. 5) VERIFY: a different read-only agent per edited batch re-checks each fact in code and that removed facts are gone. 6) HARD depth: audit rule path globs (TOO_BROAD/TOO_NARROW/DANGLING/MISSING) and purge what a model already knows. 7) Report in chat only.

name_ar: أنسنة النص بالكثافة لا بقائمة حذف
name_en: Humanize by density, with an over-correction guard
what: يزيل علامات النص الآلي التي يلاحظها القراء (المفردات والبنية) بقياس كثافتها، دون وعد بتجاوز كاشفات الذكاء الاصطناعي. — Removes the AI tells readers notice (vocabulary, structure) by scoring their density, without promising to beat AI detectors.

how: 1) Readers mostly cite vocabulary and sentence structure as tells; target those. 2) Score suspect words by density per length instead of deleting a fixed list. 3) Cap em dashes rather than banning them; treat forced rhythm (triplets, staccato fragments) as a tell, not a fix. 4) Add an over-correction guard: do not strip natural phrasing or facts while removing tells. 5) Be honest that rewrites do not make text pass trained detectors; on short texts their scores are noise.

name_ar: الترجمة الإبداعية: متى نترجم ومتى نعيد الصياغة
what: يفرز في النص ما يحتاج ترجمة حرفية وما يحتاج إعادة إبداع (تعابير، تلاعب لفظي، فكاهة)، مع قائمة كلمات لا تُترجم. — Sorts what needs literal translation from what needs transcreation (idioms, wordplay, humour), with a do-not-translate list.
when: ترجمة تسويقية، ترجمة إعلان، تعريب / marketing translation, transcreation, localize ad copy
how: 1) Inputs: content, target languages (codes or names), optional source language, formality, do-not-translate terms. 2) Flag idioms, wordplay, humour, cultural references and emotional hooks for transcreation instead of literal translation. 3) Keep brand and product names in the source language. 4) Route each language pair to the tool that handles it best and record why. 5) Quality-check meaning, tone and length; numbers, names and dates must survive (see KOSIF anchor_gate).
